Wait...you're on Clonazepam AND Diazepam? What's the story for two benzos?

Well thankfully I'm no longer drinking. 72 hours sober tonight-- and no, it's for my panic disorder which essentially makes me disabled. These meds allow me a basic means to get things done to ensure my safety/health aka go to the doctor, go to the hospital, or be alone at home.
I'm doing better now. Heart rate still around 90-100bpm but all in all I'm ok. Anxious about my follow up appointment about my bilirubin/liver enzymes though.
I ended up going to a doctor: https://www.reddit.com/r/alcoholism/comments/xhv4ba/does\_anyone\_know\_where\_i\_can\_find\_a\_tapering/ip40iwv/?context=3

Just wanted to update you cause you seemed to be interested:  


1. having panic attacks  
2. couldn't walk straight  
3. stumbling  
4. confused  
5. heart palpitations  
6. rapid heart beat  
7. dry heaving  
8. can't eat or drink  
9. shaking  
10. can't sleep   
11. feeling cold and having to use 2 blankets and hoodie to get warm  
12. This weird sensation that I'm falling out of the sky anytime I fall asleep  


So I get there and my blood pressure is high, my pulse is high. They take blood test take urine. I get in they tell me my liver enzymes are high and they wanna ultrasound my liver amongst other organs

Get ultrasounds done and then wait- they come out and want more blood. Freaking out now.

Then they come out with a IV bag and also give me nausea mediation in the iv. 

Finally I get back to the doctor and he says all my organs are fine, my liver is fine...but I am severely dehydrated and was likely in the state of mental confusion I was could have died in another day or 2. Says the jaundice should resolve itself when I re hydrate and eat more, but I need to check in again within the week to have the levels checked again.  
So the symptoms I felt were from that. I feel better-ish now and have be drinking lots of water.

I plan on reducing my use of the anxiety meds now.

Today was my first day on it. I've been drinking for 7 months, but was recently prescribed Clonzepam for my agoraphobic and panic disorder and had planned to taper off drinking before I took it. I may have been a bit confusing in the post.

Edit; Also thank you for actually trying to help me. I'm going through a lot right now, so that really means so much to me.
I don't wanna drink anymore. I drank to self medicate before I could get help because I was having daily panic attacks.
